lines.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, writes to Timothy, his true child in the faith.
Paul urged Timothy to stay on at Corinth to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines.
Myths and endless genealogies promote speculation, but the goal of Paul's instruction is love from a pure heart.
Some turned aside to empty talk, wanting to be teachers of the law while understanding what they say.

wrong_details.true: do not understand what they are saying

lines.text: The law is good if used legitimately, and sound teaching agrees with the glorious gospel entrusted to Paul.
